edits.old: Then GET /reports/measures requires Reporting, right R, with the scope applied
edits.new: Then GET /reports/measures requires the right Reporting, code R, and the scope of the caller is applied to every row

edits.old: Then the three contract fakes answer the path and the payload of 12.1, the shape of the consumed readiness answer and the merged screen section, and the contract tests compare each fake with the document and fail on any drift
edits.new:
Then the three contract fakes answer the path and the payload of 12.1, the shape of the consumed readiness answer and the merged screen section, and the contract tests compare each fake with the document and fail on any drift

  Scenario: AC10 Each business rule of section 8 is checked against the document and its answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR11 of section 8
    When each rule is compared with the document and with the answer of GET /reports/measures
    Then BR1 and BR6 hold: the document declares one REST base and lists only operations owned by rwb-reporting
    Then BR2 and BR5 hold: event names follow the platform pattern and a schema change is additive within major version 1
    Then BR3 and BR4 hold: the read declares no Idempotency-Key and every error uses one envelope and one message ID per condition
    Then BR7 and BR8 hold: the variance is declared by the owner and the baseline is never rewritten
    Then BR9 and BR10 hold: no business value and no personal data is declared in the contract
    Then BR11 holds: the order and the period of the answer are declared in the document

  Scenario: AC11 Each provided operation declares its 404 answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the provided operations of the document
    When the error responses of GET /reports/measures are reviewed
    Then the 404 answer is declared with the platform envelope and its message ID is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P9-E6037-CON-AC11)

  Scenario: AC12 A retried or timed-out activity keeps the freshness rule (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the readiness activity of AC8 with its 2 s budget
    When the activity is retried or exceeds its budget
    Then X-Data-As-Of is omitted as AC7 states when the business date is not known inside the budget
    Then the retry count of the activity is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P9-E6037-CON-AC12)

| TC-P9-E6037-CON-13 | AC11 | Contract | The 404 answer of GET /reports/measures with the platform envelope; message ID Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P9-E6037-CON-AC11) |
| TC-P9-E6037-CON-14 | AC12 | Contract | The 2 s budget on the readiness activity; a retried or timed-out call omits X-Data-As-Of; retry count Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P9-E6037-CON-AC12) |

disposition.note: Confirmed in AC2 to AC4 and AC8: baselineDate default, row properties, variance arithmetic, bounded array, and no event type of its own. No edit needed.
AC6 Then step now names the right code R and applies the caller's scope to every row, replacing the vague with the scope applied wording.
Added AC10 covering BR1 to BR11 in section 7 and test case TC-P9-E6037-CON-12 in section 16.
Added AC11 for the 404 answer and TC-P9-E6037-CON-13. The message ID is recorded as Not specified in the source documents.
Added AC12 for activity retry and timeout, tied to AC7 and AC8, and TC-P9-E6037-CON-14. The retry count is recorded as Not specified in the source documents.
